originSemantics.LIVE_PREGAME: Certified live production-era pregame prediction rows; too close to production semantics for NBA current-era shadow.
originSemantics.HISTORICAL_WALK_FORWARD_REPLAY: Historical walk-forward replay rows; not a real future prediction regime.
originSemantics.HISTORICAL_REPLAY_SHADOW: Quarantined historical replay diagnostics; not current/future evidence.
originSemantics.LEGACY_PRE_CERTIFICATION: Legacy rows without certified regime separation; not suitable for new current-era writes.
originSemantics.CURRENT_ERA_SHADOW: Real forward pregame predictions generated from current evidence, explicitly shadow-only.

futureCompatibility.settlement: Current Era Shadow rows are real forward rows and can later settle naturally using canonical NBA settlement while remaining production-performance isolated.
futureCompatibility.stakeEngine: Probability, confidence, odds, implied probability, edge, EV, market, selection, line, freshness and price-binding lineage remain preservable for RISK-01 shadow stake simulation.
futureCompatibility.continuousLearning: Rows can later feed shadow evaluation and challenger analysis after settlement, with no automatic retraining or promotion.
